args.usage:
Usage:
  zipover                      Start syncing; shows a pairing code on first launch
  zipover --pair <6-digit code> Pair, then continue syncing
  zipover --tray               Start the desktop app
  zipover devices              List paired devices
  zipover forget <device ID>   Unpair a device (quit syncing first)
  zipover copy <file or folder>...

Both computers continue syncing automatically after pairing; no restart is needed.
Use --device <name or ID> when multiple devices are ready to pair.
Network options: --listen <IP:port> changes the listening address.
--connect <host:port> connects directly (saves the device address after pairing).
